title_en: Doctors and Pharmacies (17/20): Recovering at Home
note_en: 正是因为……才…… stresses that one cause, and no other, made something possible: 正是因为妈妈的照顾，她才能这么快恢复健康 "It was precisely because of Mom's care that she was able to recover so quickly." English needs the cleft sentence "it was ... that ..."; Chinese gets the same emphasis by putting 正是 in front of the cause and 才 before the result.
